findings.title: Delete filtered by primary key and business state
findings.description: The DELETE combines an ID filter with a COMPANY_STATE filter. If ID is the primary key, the state predicate is redundant for row identity and a stale companyState silently deletes zero rows instead of raising an error. Whether the guard is intended requires runtime schema and business confirmation (unverified).
findings.recommendation: Confirm whether the COMPANY_STATE guard is intentional; if not, delete by ID alone and treat the affected-row count as the authoritative result signal.

findings.title: Untyped parameter map
findings.description: parameterType="java.util.Map" leaves parameter keys untyped, so a misspelled key (e.g. companyStat) fails only at runtime rather than at compile time.
findings.recommendation: Replace the java.util.Map parameter with a typed parameter object or @Param annotations so parameter names are validated at compile time.
